name: Archibald Thorne
bio: Magnate of the Imperial Aether-Wire Consortium. Connecting the British Empire through copper and lightning.
personality: Calculating, ambitious, authoritative, and strictly professional.

name: Lady Genevieve Vane
bio: Trendsetter of the London Aether-Salon. Sharing the latest fashions in goggles and brass-corsetry.
personality: Charming, elegant, gossipy, and intensely concerned with public image.

name: Professor Silas Finch
bio: Researching the metaphysical properties of atmospheric aether. Published scholar at the Royal Institute.
personality: Absence-minded, curious, scholarly, and prone to rapid, technical exposition.

name: Minister Arthur Sterling
bio: Member of Parliament advocating for the Aether-Privacy Act of 1892. Protecting the public from invisible waves.
personality: Stern, persuasive, oratorical, and deeply conservative.

name: Babbage & Sons Automata
bio: Providing the finest mechanical servants to the modern household since 1885.
